basic_details.job_title: CSVTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Chhattisgarh Swami Vivekanand Technical University, Bhilai (C.G.) (CSVTU) has invited applications for 3 posts of Assistant Professor under Advt No. CSVTU./Advt/2026/R-02. The online application is open from 18 November 2026 to 19 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Paid during online form submission; non-refundable.

qualification.education_qualification: B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or Integrated M.Tech. in relevant branch with First Class or equivalent in any one of the Degrees.
qualification.details: Qualification: B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or Integrated M.Tech. in relevant branch with First Class or equivalent in any one of the Degrees; Ph.D directly after B.E./B.Tech. is applicable if awarded in relevant discipline by a recognized University as prescribed by UGC or by an Institute of national importance, with at least first class at Bachelor's level Age limit: 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: PhD degree holders 5 years as per Ordinance of the University, Domiciled candidates of Chhattisgarh As per Government of Chhattisgarh directives; no relaxation beyond 45 years of age | Other conditions: | Reservation is provided to domiciled candidates of Chhattisgarh as per Government of Chhattisgarh norms If no class/division is awarded, minimum 60% aggregate is treated as first class; CGPA converted as per the notice's table Eligibility is considered as on the last date of submission of the online application form | Desirable: | Preference may be given to shortlisted candidates who have published research papers in SCI journals, UGC approved journals or AICTE approved list of journals Applicants having higher qualification and good academic records shall be given preference

exam_pattern.details: Objective type multiple choice questions with four choices 04 marks for each correct answer Negative marking: 01 mark deducted for every wrong answer attempted Syllabus: Computer Organization and Architecture, Programming and Data Structures, Algorithms, Theory of Computation, Compiler Design, Operating System, Databases, Computer Networks

how_to_apply: Submit the application online through the University website www.csvtu.ac.in from 18-11-2026, 11.00 a.m. to 19-12-2026, 05:30 p.m.
A user manual for application form submission is available on the University website.
Pay the non-refundable fee during online form submission.
Upload the appropriate documents clearly as given in the online application form.
Send the printout of the online form with self-attested copies of all supporting documents by registered/speed post only.
Hard copy must reach The Registrar (Recruitment Cell), CSVTU, Newai, Bhilai, Distt-Durg (C.G.) 491107 by 04-01-2027, 05:30 p.m.

content_sections.heading: Key Points
content_sections.text: Last date: 19 December 2026 Vacancies: 3 How to apply: Online Fee: SC/ST candidates of CG Domicile: Rs. 1500; Other candidates: Rs. 2500 Pay: Pay Level 10, Entry Pay ₹57700 Age limit: 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026) Place: University Teaching Department, Chhattisgarh Swami Vivekanand Technical University, Bhilai

content_sections.heading: CSVTU Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. CSVTU./Advt/2026/R-02 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CSVTU notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or Integrated M.Tech. in relevant branch with First Class or equivalent in any one of the Degrees; Ph.D directly after B.E./B.Tech. is applicable if awarded in relevant discipline by a recognized University as prescribed by UGC or by an Institute of national importance, with at least first class at Bachelor's level Age limit: 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: PhD degree holders 5 years as per Ordinance of the University, Domiciled candidates of Chhattisgarh As per Government of Chhattisgarh directives; no relaxation beyond 45 years of age Other conditions: Reservation is provided to domiciled candidates of Chhattisgarh as per Government of Chhattisgarh norms If no class/division is awarded, minimum 60% aggregate is treated as first class; CGPA converted as per the notice's table Eligibility is considered as on the last date of submission of the online application form Desirable: Preference may be given to shortlisted candidates who have published research papers in SCI journals, UGC approved journals or AICTE approved list of journals Applicants having higher qualification and good academic records shall be given preference

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for CSVTU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates coming to the interview without original certificates will not be permitted to appear Late submitted applications will not be considered Applications without required certificates/documents/photograph/fee will be rejected Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment on regular basis Probation period of three years from the date of joining Service terms governed by rules/ordinance of CSVTU, Bhilai and Government of Chhattisgarh

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Paid during online form submission; non-refundable.

rows.event: Hard copy must reach University (05:30 p.m.)

content_sections.heading: How Will CSVTU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written test Academic record assessment Interview Selection based on performance in written test, academic record assessment and interview as decided by the University Shortlisting for interview from those who qualify the written test, on a ratio against the advertised post decided by the University Interview schedule and list of shortlisted candidates will be notified on the University website Date, time and centre of the written test will be mentioned in the admit card

content_sections.heading: CSVTU Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Objective type multiple choice questions with four choices 04 marks for each correct answer Negative marking: 01 mark deducted for every wrong answer attempted Syllabus: Computer Organization and Architecture, Programming and Data Structures, Algorithms, Theory of Computation, Compiler Design, Operating System, Databases, Computer Networks

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Printout/hard copy of the online application form Self-attested copies of documents on academic/research performance, academic credentials, accomplishments and other relevant annexures Caste certificate from competent authority of Government of Chhattisgarh for reserved categories Valid income certificate for OBC (Non Creamy Layer) candidates No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the appointee at interview, for employed applicants Original certificates at interview, including date of birth, relevant experience, Aadhar card and PAN card

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSVTU Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Submit the application online through the University website www.csvtu.ac.in from 18-11-2026, 11.00 a.m. to 19-12-2026, 05:30 p.m. A user manual for application form submission is available on the University website. Pay the non-refundable fee during online form submission. Upload the appropriate documents clearly as given in the online application form. Send the printout of the online form with self-attested copies of all supporting documents by registered/speed post only. Hard copy must reach The Registrar (Recruitment Cell), CSVTU, Newai, Bhilai, Distt-Durg (C.G.) 491107 by 04-01-2027, 05:30 p.m.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSVTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 19 December 2026. Applications opened on 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CSVTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies for Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CSVTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 19 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: SC/ST candidates of CG Domicile: Rs. 1500. Other candidates: Rs. 2500.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: PhD degree holders 5 years as per Ordinance of the University, Domiciled candidates of Chhattisgarh As per Government of Chhattisgarh directives; no relaxation beyond 45 years of age.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay Level 10, Entry Pay ₹57700.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or Integrated M.Tech. in relevant branch with First Class or equivalent in any one of the Degrees.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Reservation is provided to domiciled candidates of Chhattisgarh as per Government of Chhattisgarh norms. If no class/division is awarded, minimum 60% aggregate is treated as first class; CGPA converted as per the notice's table. Eligibility is considered as on the last date of submission of the online application form.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates coming to the interview without original certificates will not be permitted to appear. Late submitted applications will not be considered. Applications without required certificates/documents/photograph/fee will be rejected. Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written test. Academic record assessment. Interview. Selection based on performance in written test, academic record assessment and interview as decided by the University.
